newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY LARGELY FIRMER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY LARGELY FIRMER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer against most hard units at the close of Wednesday's interbank session, foreign exchange dealers said.
"It looks like there was a bit of money coming into the market. I think we're starting to see some inflows from the tobacco sales," one dealer commented.
He said the local unit appreciated to 11.2925/3025 against the U.S. dollar but finished at 11.2975/3075 after the central Reserve Bank intervened to mop up the excess foreign currency.
On Tuesday the Zimbabwe dollar closed at 11.3050/3150.

Against the mark, it ended the day at 6.5450/5575 from 6.5495/5520 and was also quoted firmer on the rand at 2.5400/5500 compared to 2.5410/5445. It however lost against sterling to 18.4695/4800 from 18.3360/3470, reflecting the British currency's gains over the U.S. dollar overseas.
